projectMeta.name: Acorn → Clarity Trees (living spec)
projectMeta.passphrase: clarity tree typed fields living specification

uhCEk6E6EM8nXqpUVJQb72sgT2IRR3F0rbZJNTL9.content: Acorn renders clarity trees whose every node guides an agent toward production-ready software

uhCEkLI746hkaUxjd9kez7_Sf3oBFpHU_f7LZNvC.content: Working with an LLM agent uses low-friction diff export/import, not full-tree round-trips

uhCEkpY8Q6BL7PMIhFiUv5AG0-KkPxFp7y0JWJBs.content: A human can export the changes since the last export as a diff

taskList.task: Persist a 'last export' snapshot at a known location
Compute the delta (added / changed / removed nodes, connections, fields) since the snapshot
Write the diff to the known location

uhCEk57Hqc9nCJCqP7iyCXeIoqnf0nW4WLbMkWs2.content: A human can import LLM-generated diffs into an existing tree

taskList.task: Parse the diff format (shared with export-diff)
Resolve node references against the existing tree; report unresolved
Apply adds / updates / removes in place (zome create/update/delete + ref remap)

uhCEkjkWOnQo0SS3r_e_sUP1-gj4HcnvY0GTpgm_.content: Imported diffs light up the tree where changes happened

uhCEkrkvuEyfGiHjJks95NttfXDE4kN0QJssF2n1.content: Changed nodes show a glowy outline, distinct from selection

taskList.task: Add a 'recently changed' ephemeral set (separate from selection)
Render a glow outline for changed nodes in drawOutcome
Clear it on acknowledge / background click

uhCEkaikMGqxOCdorIQzz8I0Bpa_Wo5S600w1V6w.content: A +/- badge shows how many additions, edits, and deletions a diff made

taskList.task: Compute add / edit / delete counts from the diff
Render a +/- green/red badge

uhCEk1avTL7kZKpTn4IAb2BOSoHOdGX-fRQizlwy.content: The view zooms to fit all changed nodes, with none selected

taskList.task: Compute the bounding box of the changed nodes from the layout
Set the viewport to fit that box with padding
Select no single node

uhCEkoe0xV-HbOMDZVx-xNGnKh2eVXg1D7HCuuIk.content: Field changes and leaf checklist changes both count as changed

taskList.task: computeProjectDiff compares the whole outcome (fields + taskList)

uhCEky7BIR1FLkNFivC2Ae_p9dsHLMUuz2UuSWmu.content: Export and import are single-click against a known location

taskList.task: Define a known, configurable location for the diff + last-export snapshot
Single-click export-diff and import-diff buttons
No file picker on the common path

uhCEkNBxVJKIBPKsHpGypkxFM5Q4f_SziV7sV_5z.content: Applying a diff never deletes a node the agent didn't explicitly mark for removal

taskList.task: Apply a handed diff directly (explicit adds/updates/removes); never infer deletions
For a full-tree apply, confirm each deletion separately before removing
The agent works in diffs from the latest export, not a stale full tree

uhCEkM3zC7hyRuHY6-pOPEIO1HB76wR94bKiwDUG.content: Every node's content is stored as an extensible set of typed clarity fields

uhCEkOeH80HSeE8nopz4ZGxgk_qg-DHR3aUaLU92.content: A node's detailed outcome statement is a field distinct from its one-line name

taskList.task: Bind the editor outcome widget to fields.outcome via parseFields/serializeFields
Route read-sites (search, list) through getOutcomeStatement
Preserve any other fields on save (parse, replace outcome, serialize)

uhCEkWFlcKYfXzDGgF9WvK25sZSsS9brFd1c7daX.content: The outcome editor renders an editable widget for each clarity field

uhCEkH7bt5Q2f1q0DMXZKrqxadSnQbg0si60i_d3.content: The editor binds a markdown widget to each text field, with a registry composing the other field widgets

taskList.task: Render the outcome (description) field as markdown with click-to-edit
Render the spec field with the same markdown widget
Define a field-type registry so each OutcomeFields key maps to its widget
Route artifacts to the artifacts list editor (branch E)

uhCEk1EkM6egXVB-G0B4BI3h2L2aDDn5wIjQqCNT.content: Unknown field types fall back to a raw-JSON widget so nothing is lost

taskList.task: Detect field keys with no registered widget
Render those in a raw-JSON editor bound through serializeFields

uhCEku_NNzG3NZFRZ4cTt2v4dZd4AjSzcprMW5C4.content: A node carries a functional spec field describing required shape, not just the outcome

taskList.task: Add optional fields.spec (text)
Add an optional latitude marker {design | specification | implementation}

uhCEkubfmi2dKigGifr3bKiOaoZgC33Z56btKYZp.content: Completion criteria attached at any node level determine that node's achievement

uhCEklYaUoL6aBihgsjgjIYkq2vd2FBRhVqRSNAh.content: Every completion criterion names an evaluator: human, executable, or LLM

taskList.task: Criterion schema {statement, evaluator, evidence}
Executable evaluator runs a command/url and captures evidence
Human evaluator exposes a stamp/approve affordance
LLM evaluator submits statement + artifact for judgement

uhCEkDANpYz4vdTXSy6N1_9h7siSMw9j5icT01Oc.content: A leaf becomes Achieved as the recorded consequence of meeting a completion criterion, not a bare human toggle

taskList.task: A leaf cannot be Achieved without at least one met completion criterion as its basis
Record which criterion (and its evidence) grounded the achievement
Human 'mark done' becomes evaluating a manual-review criterion, not a contentless flag

uhCEkBdkxZ6g2Dr5IUXhzblrbYfV-Mk6HLZsGBu-.content: A Small's achievement follows from its tasks being checked and its criteria met, not an independent toggle

taskList.task: Surface the task list as the editable working breakdown (todos) on each Small
Compute Achieved from all-tasks-checked AND completion-criteria-met
Stop allowing an independent achieved toggle that bypasses tasks and criteria

uhCEkSPOeNgzPHckRmH1P44qa61Fz646ksRrKC_J.content: Branch nodes carry integration-test completion criteria that ground their achievement, not just propagation

taskList.task: A branch can author its own completion criteria (often executable integration tests over its children)
Branch achievement = children propagation AND the branch's own criteria passing
Flag the case where all children are achieved but the branch's integration criterion fails

uhCEkwXS03lXAIb4W2DxnXnCzAkORjvi3LxP46zR.content: Executable completion criteria re-run to keep prior outcomes provably intact

taskList.task: Re-run executable criteria when the work changes
Surface a newly-failing criterion as red on its node
Tint the ancestors of a red node

uhCEk6YIduSUC1SIFSvuKqVuLFIhTYi94Ko1gkGT.content: Each node displays its completion verdicts, which roll up into computed achievement

taskList.task: Render each criterion's verdict on the node
Fold criterion pass/fail into computed-achievement propagation

uhCEkieAibYGMcvtn1lyRf_1msc9edH-g4BWyAF5.content: A node stores computed evaluation results separately from its authored fields, and they drive its color

taskList.task: Cache computed results (achievement, completion verdicts, smallness readiness) on the node
Recompute a result when its input fields/verdicts change
Map computed results to color/visual state, never to an editable widget

uhCEkBPTJb73-OqxC2VjRK9YXI2utRetaba9YAed.content: Every dependency declares which of three relation types it is

uhCEk8bxglFhjBpQ_GFBS_hvEOEAR0gLC7aHpBs_.content: Assembly is expressed as a constituted-from relation between a parent and its children

taskList.task: Existing connections import as constituted-from relations
constituted-from is the default relation type

uhCEkfaM_7AVsyA137xP7ZD3jrSUiEFviPY3BLIC.content: Conformance to an external standard is expressed as an informational reliance relation

taskList.task: A node can point at a spec/standard (in- or cross-tree) as an informational reliance
Informational reliance renders distinctly from constituted-from

uhCEkRMdCYEIMTKZxRCnqcWlk01Zgh5n9q7ogxP7.content: Runtime carriers a node needs are expressed as embodied reliance relations

taskList.task: A node lists the live carriers it relies on
An agent can query a node's embodied reliances and health-check each

uhCEkysNzgdb5hWzDyHHTWWHrRQXPmU3SvZPBn5m.content: Adding a second parent to a node is the moment Acorn asks: composed-of or relies-on?

taskList.task: On creating a connection that gives a child more than one parent, prompt for the relation type
Offer composed-of (constituted-from) vs relies-on; for relies-on, informational vs embodied
Default the first/assembly parent to composed-of; store the chosen type on the connection

uhCEkPA8j-8QAQbe93fp7y07_Mge2fOjSt6D6cx9.content: Agents build from the exported clarity tree and their results return into it

uhCEk99qiDBvARFAXLlUODKDs-CRela7JvKBVmw7.content: Acorn exports a clarity tree as a deterministic, agent-consumable specification

taskList.task: Define a clarity-spec export schema
Flatten each node's typed fields into the export
Round-trip test: export then re-import yields an equivalent tree

uhCEkhYaq6lXWDI5QgOx5t447WCC2uPGtAV0KGwe.content: Agents post completion verdicts with evidence back onto the nodes they worked

taskList.task: API to post a verdict {pass/fail, evidence} to a node
Flip node status on a passing executable criterion

uhCEkRH7FthePVkDWxCMJ2ofyus-MEDdr_iqZHv8.content: Agents propose new typed outcomes and fields that humans approve in Acorn

taskList.task: Agent can propose a missing outcome / spec / dependency / criterion as pending
Human approves / modifies / rejects each proposal in the Acorn UI

uhCEkaRKR2Pl0wKGbpNrlPl9eYcjBsKclEvATONm.content: Every node holds a list of typed artifacts in place of a single GitHub link

uhCEk-d_L6WKleHwE6PjE4GYrg24p9NMXxtVWsO6.content: Clarity-input artifacts such as designs, docs, and references attach to any node

taskList.task: Attach typed reference artifacts (design, doc, url, mockup) to a node
Render artifacts as a labelled attachment list in the node editor

uhCEkT6D8SJj-ayVNKe8zGRW49hnXu8pisQCz9ua.content: Agents attach their workproduct to nodes as output artifacts

taskList.task: Artifact API accepts agent-produced outputs (file, PR, log)
UI distinguishes input artifacts from output workproduct

uhCEk4djd7_xa2zHs-GGsN9Q0psY1ilPq_ph27tR.content: An in-app AI chat panel lets people build and refine clarity trees in conversation

uhCEkff_BY27vLf3lifIvNTbVRokR5i4LJn97p83.content: The chat assistant sees the live tree as context on every exchange

taskList.task: Inject the current project's tree state into the assistant context each turn
Reuse the agent-consumable export (branch D) as the context payload

uhCEkHyfFw_3txiZd4sBlUyg1fjDOC1vtd1GtkOG.content: The assistant drafts and applies typed tree edits from the conversation, pending human approval

taskList.task: Assistant drafts concrete edits: new outcomes, field values, typed dependencies
Edits surface as pending proposals via the same path agents use (branch D3)
Human accepts / modifies / rejects each edit inline in the chat

uhCEkhWZJAzmDX4u0kE_MBw1ujvTsdU0aSJ4CPIA.content: The conversation that shaped a branch is retained as an artifact on that branch

taskList.task: Attach the chat transcript to the branch it produced or refined
Store it as an artifact of type conversation (branch E)

uhCEkGP279L7-haknjUEaxsng5UHWFj22FZxkNF-.content: A leaf's readiness to be a Small is computed from its clarity signals, not declared by hand

uhCEkzSpWIwi3KvfNSrdO_115eBMGfJHXuM_fFUd.content: Each leaf's smallness readiness is a cached gradient, recomputed from its signals and rendered as the leaf's color

taskList.task: Aggregate the readiness signals into a 0..1 gradient
Clamp the gradient to not-ready when any binary blocker is active
Recompute on input change and map the result to the leaf's color ramp

uhCEkYY5ant3n7uWFTe2za4BtwHhNk3GrmUCuhkN.content: A leaf's complexity estimate is a gradient input to its readiness

taskList.task: Surface a continuous complexity/uncertainty estimate on every leaf
Feed the estimate into computed.smallReadiness; mark the breakdown threshold

uhCEkJPJRXJNVN2zv8s6T6Q2vNsOypb9mO8Cfu7C.content: The spread of the change a building agent would make is a gradient input to readiness

taskList.task: Estimate the change-spread for the building agent
Feed change-spread into computed.smallReadiness proportionally

uhCEkMTOdlAVYQXYisrEL41YyRHxqrJhxHkiHN52.content: The size of the human review surface is a gradient input to readiness

taskList.task: Surface the review surface of a leaf against its completion criteria
Feed review-surface size into computed.smallReadiness

uhCEks53FXXbQuuefsyYmdzSmIMBQ4HlLPUfvpvo.content: How much design latitude is still open in the spec is a gradient input to readiness

taskList.task: Map the spec's latitude marker and count of open decisions (branch A3) to a contribution
Lower readiness for each unresolved design decision

uhCEk6_FZzxbcRcG0GVSr-RU_C9Z6zY0s33YKbXL.content: The absence of any evaluable completion criterion is a binary blocker on readiness

taskList.task: Detect when a leaf has zero criteria concrete enough to evaluate
Clamp readiness to not-ready until a concrete criterion exists

uhCEkLdUxthmdE5RQaq6fXV6bsEEDvtFY0-_exhH.content: An unresolved open unknown is a binary blocker on readiness

taskList.task: Record a leaf's open known-unknowns, with room to flag suspected unknown-unknowns
Clamp readiness to not-ready while any unknown is unresolved

uhCEkY8iQ_pjfYOJiAqdT6-sewt0OiERrd7Aaxr6.content: When a leaf's readiness is low or blocked, the assistant proposes a decomposition into smaller outcomes

taskList.task: Trigger on low readiness or an active binary blocker
Assistant drafts candidate child outcomes that each look more ready
Proposed decompositions use the human-approval path (branches D3/F2)

uhCEkCOlKRj3x4Xn-Wz_Vz3SDf-E2O65pzLGEaXV.content: Multi-user co-editing works seamlessly across all changes
